_doc: Blind accuracy census (cycle 76): every pooled number independently re-extracted from committed source by an offline checker BLIND to the stored value; deterministic compare; disagreements hand-adjudicated against source. See scripts/error_rate_compare.py + error_rate_pass2.py.
measured_against: docs/error_rate_sample.json (the committed sample of every pooled number at measurement time)
confirmed_our_errors_note: 1 wrong number (semaglutide GI-AE wrong endpoint) surfaced AND fixed this cycle; the 3 remaining disagreements are checker-side (label wording / estimand choice).
not_recheckable_note: sourced from ClinicalTrials.gov results / full text, so not re-extractable from the abstract the checker was given (not evidence of error).

adjudication.note: Numbers identical (0.80 [0.60-1.06]); we label it IRR, the checker wrote "rate ratio" (RR). A rate ratio on TOTAL/recurrent HF hospitalizations IS an incidence-rate ratio; our IRR label is correct.

ROCKET-AF: checker took the on-treatment/per-protocol HR 0.79; its own note flags the ITT HR 0.88, which is what we store — consistent with the other all-ITT NOAC trials. Our ITT choice is the standard MA choice.
ASCEND: numbers identical (0.97 [0.87-1.08]); IRR vs "rate ratio" wording only. Our IRR label is correct.

fixed_this_cycle.note: Wrong endpoint: overall-AE counts (141/161 vs 61/81) were pooled under a gastrointestinal-AE outcome; the abstract has no GI-specific count. FIXED cycle 76 via an absent-override (declared absent). This is the one confirmed defect the census surfaced; it had passed every gate.

harms_sweep_added_verified: semaglutide-obesity-mace::Adverse events leading to permanent discontinuation::37952131
build_verified_added: omega3-cardiovascular-events SU.FOL.OM3 (PMID 21115589): omega-3 main-effect marginal on major vascular events, HR 1.08 (0.79-1.47), recovered from full text (PMC2993045) after the _pmc_fulltext citing-article fix; verified against the committed source span at build time, not part of the original blind census.

probiotics-aad-prevention Wright 2015 (PMID 24456384): AAD arm counts 5/41 vs 4/46 percentage-derived from the abstract (12.2%/8.7%), RR 1.40; a genuinely eligible declared-absent trial the extractor could not parse (N received X (P%) format).

probiotics-aad-prevention ECLISP (34541475, LcS 59/131 vs 53/126, primary AAD Abx+30d, RR 1.07) and S. boulardii trial (26973849, 21/246 vs 17/231 with >=1 AAD episode, RR 1.16): double-blind placebo-controlled prevention trials recovered from full text; both move the pool toward the null.
sglt2-ckd-progression EMPA-KIDNEY DKA (36331190): 6/3304 vs 1/3305 ketoacidosis, single-trial harm row (siblings DAPA-CKD/CREDENCE source-absent, not in PMC).
tranexamic-acid-pph WOMAN thromboembolic (28456509): 30/10033 vs 34/9985 any thromboembolic event, RR 0.88; large single-trial harm (WOMAN is the topic sole treatment trial).

screening RCT-evidence recovery (cycle 84): esketamine Chen 2023 (37025256, MADRS -10.1 vs -8.1) and statins STAREE (42670961, HR 0.70) recovered via full-abstract-overrules-incomplete-pubtype; both source-verified.

esketamine TRANSFORM-1 (NCT02417064): combined 56+84mg intranasal vs shared placebo, MADRS MD -18.91+/-13.95 (n=209) vs -14.8+/-15.07 (n=108); completes esketamine conclusion change to k=4 -3.34 (-6.07,-0.62).
build_verified_note: Topics added after the original blind census (dpp4, sglt2-pp, doac-vte) are listed in build_verified_added: each pooled number was verified against its committed source at build time (doac-vte-recurrence: all six DOAC-vs-VKA recurrent-VTE counts/effects re-extracted from the trial abstracts via PubMed and matched), not part of the original independent blind Codex census.
